shortDescription: Heavy-duty sockets, drive accessories, and application-specific reaction solutions for ToughTorq bolting systems.
longDescription: ToughTorq sockets and reaction equipment complete the mechanical connection between the torque tool, fastener, and reaction point. The published socket range covers 3/4-inch, 1-inch, and 1-1/2-inch square-drive hydraulic wrench applications, while reaction equipment can be selected or customized around tool position and available geometry.
features: Socket range matched to published ToughTorq hydraulic wrench models
Metric fastener reference from M16 through M90
Socket, hexagon socket, square drive, hexagonal drive, and castle socket configurations shown in the manufacturer system
Square-drive hydraulic reaction arm can be positioned 360° on its support
Custom reaction equipment available for application-specific requirements

operatingRequirements.label: Socket Selection
operatingRequirements.value: Match square drive, fastener size, wrench model, required torque, socket clearance, and application geometry

operatingRequirements.label: Reaction Selection
operatingRequirements.value: Reaction equipment must bear against a suitable reaction point and be matched to the torque tool and application geometry

compatibility: Published socket-to-wrench compatibility is maintained at model level in the canonical data.
Reaction-arm selection depends on the torque tool, reaction point, fastener position, and available clearance.
Custom reaction arms may be required where standard reaction geometry cannot safely engage the application.
